data.one_liner: Access native chrome.* APIs to build Chrome extensions with Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-level, type-safe interface for accessing Chrome extension APIs (such as tabs, storage, alarms, runtime) using Dart and Flutter. The library builds on top of dart:js_interop and supports JavaScript and WebAssembly compilation.
use_when: You are building a Chrome extension or browser extension using Dart or Flutter
You need type-safe access to chrome.* APIs like chrome.tabs, chrome.storage, or chrome.runtime
avoid_when: You are developing a standard mobile or desktop application unrelated to browser extensions
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Chrome extension APIs
Type-safe interface built on top of dart:js_interop
Supports compilation to JavaScript and WebAssembly
weaknesses: Strictly limited to Chrome extensions and browser extension development
data.setup_notes: No special dependencies required, uses dart:js_interop.
